g.text: Domain Model Excerpt - WEB01 SPA Setup and Integration (Business Identifiers)
Guest is NOT a role: it is the absence
of a session. Roles are consumed by
Same value when referenced by the SPA,
REST, forecasts and the Prolog knowledge base.
What WEB01 requires from these aggregates
- Identifiers are generated ONLY by the back end and are
opaque strings for the SPA: never generated, parsed,
incremented or rewritten in the browser (BR 4).
- Reuse the identifier for the same resource across
the viewer uses the active kitchen configuration's
own identifier and asset references (WEB06 / VIS01).
- Business data is read and maintained ONLY through the
Back-End API (apiClient); it is not cached in browser
storage (BR 5) and is re-read after a successful change (BR 14).
- apiClient, ApiError, appConfig and the module slot are
technical concepts of the SPA (frontend/src), not domain
concepts, and are therefore not part of the domain model.
